title: Musk to Change SpaceXAI’s Name to SpaceXSI
text:
Elon Musk will change the name of SpaceX’s AI unit, SpaceXAI, to SpaceXSI, he said in a post on X on Sunday, adopting President Donald Trump’s preferred name for AI.
Musk had already signaled his agreement with Presidnet Trump that Super Intelligence, or SI, is better than the commonly used AI ...
